pages.title: Fenwick green-check blazer | Marsh & Button
pages.snippet: Dark green checks, contrasting pocket trim and enough pockets to lose your own receipt.
blocks: THE FENWICK BLAZER — Forest green check with contrasting pocket trim. Available in several sizes.
For workdays, receptions and telling somebody you need to speak to the manager without actually saying it.
Our catalogue photograph shows one styling suggestion. Shirt, trousers and air of professional competence sold separately.
Check availability with your local branch. We cannot identify a customer from a photograph of a jacket. We also cannot identify our own regional manager without her name badge.

pages.title: Green checked jackets | Second Impression Hire
pages.snippet: Jackets for conferences, interviews and occasions that unexpectedly require an iron.
blocks: Need a green checked jacket for one evening rather than the rest of your life? Our smart-casual range includes several checked styles.
Hire includes basic cleaning. Please return the jacket, its buttons and approximately the number of pockets it left with.
Exact patterns and pocket trims vary by size and availability. Ask to see the actual garment before booking.
Customer names and booking records are private. “I am being very nosy” does not qualify as written authorisation.

pages.title: Caring for a checked blazer | Pressing Matters
pages.snippet: Wool checks, decorative trim and the mysterious contents of your pockets.
blocks: A green checked blazer with contrasting pocket trim may contain several materials. Check the care label before choosing a cleaning method.
Empty every pocket before bringing it in. Conference badges, business cards and emergency biscuits are not part of the garment.
Tell us about previous repairs or borrowed clothing. We can treat a stain; we cannot negotiate who pays for it.
All collection tickets must be presented at the counter. “It was green” describes both half our rail and the accountant after seeing the electricity bill.

pages.title: Someone went home in my green jacket
pages.snippet: A reception, two similar jackets and a pocket full of somebody else’s mints.
blocks: SLEEVE_IT_OUT: “Came home from a reception wearing a green checked jacket. Mine was also green and checked. This one contains reading glasses and has much better manners.”
POCKET_SQUARE: “Try the venue’s lost property desk. Give them the size, lining and a description of the pocket trim.”
SLEEVE_IT_OUT: “Already called. They asked what was in my pockets. Apparently ‘potential’ is not specific enough.”
MODERATOR: “Please do not post strangers’ names or photographs. This is a lost-property forum, not a public trial with coat hangers.”
